ov: A small, nimble goat-antelope of the rugged mountains of Europe, Turkey and the Caucasus. Both sexes have short horns hooked back at the tip. Its coat is rich brown in summer and grey in winter, with bold black and white face markings.

why.et: A popular game animal hunted for its meat.

rg: Mountains of Europe from the Pyrenees and Alps to the Carpathians and Balkans, plus Turkey and the Caucasus; introduced to New Zealand.
df: Mountain grasses and herbs in summer; conifers, bark and needles in winter.
fx: Can run at 50 km/h and jump 2 m straight up or 6 m across.
Hunters stalk it from above, because it tends to watch for danger coming from below.
